caseName: Vurimindi v. Hoopskirt Lofts Condo. Ass'n
caseNameFull: Vamsidhar VURIMINDI v. The HOOPSKIRT LOFTS CONDOMINIUM ASSOCIATION.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and petition for writ of certiorari to the Commonwealth Court of Pennsylvania dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
